Robert Lowry first called it Beautiful River. Its tune was later named Hanson Place, after the Brooklyn church where he sometimes served as a Baptist minister.

It was one of the film director John Ford's favourite hymns, and he used it in many of his westerns, Stagecoach and The Searchers among them.
